failed_original_audit.reason: Two public audit methods lacked required documentation; no observations were run.
failed_original_audit.corrected_source_difference: Two documentation comment lines only; timing sources unchanged.

dependency_checks.normalization: Full source origin, package/version, renamed edge, dependency kind/target, features; wrapper/path identities normalized only after verifying expected manifest paths. Root dependency edges included.

untimed_digest_checks.scope: Padded upload bytes/counts and FNV64 mask/vertex digests match master; no exact GPU image comparison or cache-hit measurement.

statistics.method: Independently sum phase durations within each trial, median five trials per process, pair twelve whole Williams blocks, median paired changes; whole-block percentile bootstrap with recorded seed, without importing benchmark statistical functions.

limitations: Targeted Roboto public-API CPU draw+flush stress with fresh atlas per phase and retained shared TextContext; not normal warmed-atlas behavior or application latency.
Canvas/context creation, font registration, request construction and Canvas destruction are outside timers; all ten measured phases include cold population.
Neither timing nor digest audit measures outline hits, physical memory, allocator copies or exact GPU RGBA output.
Prior to updated45 changes both admission growth and scaler identity; final to master includes the full cache and fixes, so this does not isolate each change causally.
One font and one arm64 macOS host; exact Vec growth and allocator behavior can differ elsewhere.
Twelve paired process blocks are the independent resampling units; five trials and ten phases are nested observations, not independent replicates.
Intervals are exploratory 95% intervals without multiplicity or workload-selection adjustment. Paired percentages need not equal ratios of unpaired medians.
